configurePresets.name: hpc-release
configurePresets.description: Optimized, hardened build for distribution and CI. Portable across modern x86-64 CPUs (no -march=native). Strict warnings live on the project's own targets, not here, so FetchContent deps (googletest, nlohmann/json) don't trip -Werror.

configurePresets.name: hpc-debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimized build for tracing the residual through diffusion_kernel.f90 -> JacobiCPU -> ProfilingHarness in GDB. Standalone (does NOT inherit hpc-release) so no -O3/-march leaks in and nothing reads as <optimized out>. C++ and Fortran are both -g -O0 so stepping descends through the extern "C" boundary into laplace_2d_jacobi; CUDA gets -G so cuda-gdb can enter the solve_vram kernels. Bounds-checked on BOTH sides: gfortran -fcheck=all on the kernels, libstdc++ -D_GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS on C++ container access (cheap, GDB-friendly) so an out-of-bounds index that would silently corrupt a residual is caught. Builds into build-debug/ to match ./build-debug/physi_sim.
